highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.0 modernizes the bindings, renderer, and supported platform integrations for current .NET applications.
highlights_body: The preview line adds new graphics APIs, refreshed native dependencies, expanded desktop and mobile support, and removes long-obsolete APIs.

breaking.title: Obsolete APIs were removed
breaking.body: APIs previously marked obsolete were removed for the v3 release. Update code to the recommended replacement APIs and rebuild before moving to this version.

breaking.title: Platform view integrations were modernized
breaking.body: Several platform-view packages and target frameworks changed as part of the v3 refresh. Update package references and platform project settings to their current supported equivalents.

bullets.detail: The preview line updates Skia through milestone m116 and refreshes HarfBuzz, WebP, and libjpeg-turbo.
The release adds SKBlender, Skottie animation support, expanded SKPicture APIs, shader conversion, and span overloads for point and color-filter operations.
Fixes address Metal snapshot colors, cloned SKPaint disposal, kerning adjustment results, and pixel-span offset handling.
SkiaSharp adds accelerated WinUI views, WPF GL support, Mac Catalyst Metal rendering, and updated mobile and WebAssembly integrations.
